consumer: game::handle_action dispatching ACTION_MOVE_* asks the engine to execute a registered planar movement action against the destination tile.
scope: The full move-action effect through the engine's own active input loop: dispatch the registered movement action and let avatar_action::move resolve tile-specific behavior (NPC swap/displace/menu vs blocked no-op).
decisive_source: src/handle_action.cpp::game::handle_action (ACTION_MOVE_* case) — consumes the registered movement action and calls avatar_action::move(u, m, dest_delta), clearing destination on a failed move.
divergence: Avatar steps into a friendly NPC's tile: the real action triggers a position swap/displace (or interaction menu), whereas a wall is a blocked no-op — a surface only reporting moved/not-moved cannot distinguish the swap from a plain step or a blocked wall.
